title: SMS
needsAccount: This part needs an account — sign in when you have a connection.

setup.title: Phone settings
setup.notDefault: This app is not yet the phone's SMS app — new messages go to another one, and you can't send from here.
setup.refused: The phone didn't allow it? On GrapheneOS and Android 13+ an app from outside the store must first get permission: App settings → ⋮ → „Allow restricted settings", then „Set as the SMS app" again. Before switching, turn off chat (RCS) in Google Messages.
setup.rcs: Google Messages is also on the phone. If it had chat (RCS) on, your number may still be registered for chat: messages from people who use it then arrive late or not at all. Briefly set Google Messages as the SMS app, turn off Settings → RCS chats in it, and come back here.
setup.noContacts: Without access to contacts, numbers stand in place of names, and contacts from recreatio won't reach the phone.

unsent.body: Messages the phone didn't send (failed and stuck), older than 10 minutes, will be deleted. Sent ones are not affected.

check.notDefault: This app is not the phone's SMS app — new messages go to another one.
check.ok: Checked — everything that reached the phone is here.
check.otherSms: Google Messages is also installed: if chat (RCS) is on there, some messages go there.

blocked.title: Blocked numbers
blocked.unblockBody: The phone will again accept SMS and calls from this number.
blocked.notSystem: The phone doesn't let this app block in the system (it is not the SMS app) — only the app itself blocks.

thread.onItsWay: This message is already on its way.
thread.archiveOn: This conversation will be archived — all of it, including older messages.
thread.archiveOff: This conversation will no longer be archived (what is already in the archive stays).
thread.blockedApp: Blocked (in this app) and the conversation deleted.
thread.blockedArchive: It was also deleted from the archive.
thread.removeAsk: Delete this conversation from the phone?
thread.removeBody: All its messages will disappear from the phone. The archive stays unchanged.
thread.archiveNotOn: The archive is not switched on yet
thread.remove: Delete the conversation from the phone…
thread.archiveStarted: SMS archive turned on — for now with this one conversation (all of it, including older messages). Add others the same way or in Archive.

compose2.separate: Separately to each (SMS — nobody sees the others)
compose2.asGroup: As a group (MMS — everyone sees the replies)
